about.paragraph1: I’m a junior full-stack developer who enjoys learning by building. Over the past few years I’ve worked on real projects involving websites, e-commerce and applications built from scratch.
about.paragraph2: I’ve worked with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, PHP, MongoDB and MySQL, as well as tools and platforms such as WordPress, PrestaShop and WooCommerce.
about.paragraph3: My experience has introduced me to different parts of development: from building interfaces and features to working with data, databases and communication between parts of an application.
about.paragraph4: I don’t claim to know everything. I enjoy tackling problems I haven’t solved yet, researching, trying different approaches and learning along the way. AI is part of my workflow, helping me learn, research and develop more efficiently while I review and understand everything I do.
about.paragraph5: I want to keep growing as a developer, especially in full-stack development, React, backend, APIs, databases and application development, while contributing to real projects and taking on more responsibility.
about.paragraph6: I believe I can bring curiosity, a willingness to learn, commitment and a desire to do things well.

experience.summary: I build websites for real clients by first understanding their goals, defining the structure and planning the right solution. Once the project is planned, I develop the site using carefully chosen prompts and AI tools to work efficiently without replacing technical judgment, review or tailoring.

Built a web-based order management platform from scratch. I worked on the React frontend, MongoDB database and GitHub repository, using Claude, GitHub Copilot and Codex as development tools, working in VS Code and completing training courses on Moodle.

Helped create websites for real clients, taking full responsibility for the finished product. I built solutions with WordPress and complementary technologies, managed data in Excel and delivered projects directly, shaped around each client’s specific requirements.

Completed a nine-month internship at LaPrimeraWeb as part of my advanced vocational diploma. I contributed to web development, digital design, business audits and client outreach, visiting local businesses to present services. I learned about business analysis and auditing while building sites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, WordPress and PrestaShop; creating logos and visual assets with Canva, FlexClip and DALL·E; managing large Excel databases; creating GPT agents with ChatGPT and DeepSeek; and automating social media with Make.

skillGroups.name: HTML5
skillGroups.description: I use HTML to structure web content with clear semantics, a logical heading hierarchy, accessible forms and a solid foundation for design and SEO.

skillGroups.name: CSS3
skillGroups.description: The visual layer behind my projects: Flexbox and Grid layouts, responsive design without frameworks, lightweight animation and reusable variables and themes.

skillGroups.name: JavaScript
skillGroups.description: My everyday language in the browser and on the server with Node.js. I use it to build interface logic, consume APIs and solve practical project problems.

skillGroups.name: TypeScript
skillGroups.description: Typed JavaScript that helps me catch errors early, document data structures and refactor professional projects with confidence.

skillGroups.name: React
skillGroups.description: My main library for building interfaces with reusable components, hooks and state management. I’ve used it in real management tools and complete client websites.

skillGroups.name: Next.js
skillGroups.description: The React framework I choose when discoverability and performance matter: hybrid rendering, localized routes, page metadata and Cloudflare deployment with OpenNext.

skillGroups.name: Angular
skillGroups.description: A complete framework for large SPAs, with dependency injection, routing and a structured architecture that supports scalable teamwork.

skillGroups.name: A11y (WCAG)
skillGroups.description: I apply web accessibility principles throughout my work: semantic HTML, full keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast and screen-reader support.

skillGroups.name: Tailwind CSS
skillGroups.description: My go-to styling framework. Atomic utilities speed up development and keep interfaces consistent, including custom themes, dark mode and responsive layouts.

skillGroups.name: Framer Motion
skillGroups.description: A React animation library I use for view transitions, scroll reveals, gestures and subtle interactions that make interfaces feel polished.

skillGroups.name: React Query
skillGroups.description: Server-state management with automatic caching, background revalidation and data synchronization, especially useful for API-driven applications.

skillGroups.name: Zustand
skillGroups.description: A lightweight global store for client state, useful when many components need shared state without unnecessary boilerplate.

skillGroups.name: React Hook Form
skillGroups.description: My default for forms: fast rendering, built-in validation and a great pairing with Zod for complex order and contact forms.

skillGroups.name: Zod
skillGroups.description: Shared TypeScript schema validation for client and server, keeping browser forms and API data consistent.

skillGroups.name: Node.js
skillGroups.description: The runtime I use for REST APIs, initialization scripts, automation and tools, sharing JavaScript across the full stack.

skillGroups.name: Express
skillGroups.description: A Node.js server framework for REST APIs, with authentication and validation middleware and well-organized routes.

skillGroups.name: Nodemailer
skillGroups.description: Backend email delivery for order notifications, workflow alerts and confirmations, with templates, queues and logs.

skillGroups.name: JWT
skillGroups.description: Stateless signed-token authentication. Paired with bcryptjs, it supports secure sessions with role-based permissions.

skillGroups.name: Vite
skillGroups.description: My frontend development and build tool: a fast dev server, instant hot reload and optimized production builds.

skillGroups.name: Vitest
skillGroups.description: Fast unit tests for business logic, utilities and critical components, integrated with the Vite workflow.

skillGroups.name: Playwright
skillGroups.description: End-to-end tests that exercise complete user journeys across browsers before deployment.

skillGroups.name: ESLint
skillGroups.description: Static analysis that catches issues early, aligns code style and keeps projects clean and maintainable.

skillGroups.name: Git
skillGroups.description: Version control for feature branches, clear commits and change reviews across solo and collaborative projects.
